summary: Comprehensive backend + mobile UI smoke of Traksha. Backend 21/23 pytest passed (91.3%). Two failures share ONE root cause: naive-vs-aware datetime comparison for Mongo-stored expires_at (breaks POST /api/auth/reset-password and POST /api/qr/scan → both return 500, and by extension /api/qr/connect, /api/remote/preview, /api/remote/submit). Frontend: welcome→philosophy→overview→sign-up→home flow works, TMP badge shows Day 1 of 45, Tattvaloka feed renders seeded contributions, Profile tab exposes Identity/Settings/Privacy/Safety/INS (Coming soon), QR screen renders real QR with 5-minute countdown timer and Refresh/Revoke/Scan actions, search screen renders with People/Tattvaloka toggles. No deprecated Expo packages detected (expo-av / barcode-scanner / background-fetch absent).

critical.issue: 500 TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes at server.py:437 — rec['expires_at'] (naive from Mongo) vs now_utc() (aware). Reset flow cannot complete.
500 TypeError from resolve_session at server.py:799 — s['expires_at'] naive vs now_utc() aware. Any QR/remote scan blows up because MongoDB is opened without tz_aware=True.

integration_issues.issue: Scanner manual-token submit will 500 due to backend bug above until the datetime comparison is fixed.
Reset submit will 500 due to same backend bug.

issues: Console: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (RN Web) — cosmetic warning, replace with boxShadow when convenient
Console: props.pointerEvents deprecated — move to style.pointerEvents
Console: useNativeDriver falls back to JS on web (expected in web preview, harmless)

action_items: Fix Motor client to be timezone-aware OR normalize expires_at before compare. Recommended: AsyncIOMotorClient(mongo_url, tz_aware=True) at server.py:46. This single change makes all five failing endpoints (auth/reset-password, qr/scan, qr/connect, remote/preview, remote/submit) work.

Alternative point fix: in resolve_session (server.py:799) and reset_password (server.py:437), coerce the stored datetime with `exp = s['expires_at']; if exp.tzinfo is None: exp = exp.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` before comparing to now_utc().
After fix, rerun /app/backend/tests/test_traksha_backend.py — both failing tests should pass. Also re-verify Recovery and Scanner flows on the mobile UI.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py opens AsyncIOMotorClient without tz_aware=True, so every datetime read from Mongo is naive UTC. Any Python-side comparison with now_utc() (aware) will TypeError. Only Mongo-side ($gt/$lte in queries) is safe — that is why the scheduler_loop and availability windows work while resolve_session/reset_password fail.

run_transition ignores that the transitioned document already had transition_due_at $lte now — safe, but note the dev/simulate-transition endpoint sets transition_due_at=now_utc() then reads the doc back before calling run_transition; that read returns naive datetimes and is currently only fine because run_transition doesn't compare them.
File length 1372 lines — still manageable but approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting by domain (auth, connections, messaging, calls, tattvaloka) into routers.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — browsers will strip credentials on wildcard. Fine for dev, tighten before prod.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all screens sampled render; QR/reset flows blocked by backend bug)

seed_data_creation: Only ephemeral TEST_-prefixed accounts created via /api/auth/register. No persistent seed added; existing Tattvaloka seed content used as-is.
context_for_next_testing_agent: One-line fix (tz_aware=True on Motor client) resolves both backend failures. After applying, rerun `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_traksha_backend.py -v` and confirm 23/23. Then hit /api/qr/scan and /api/auth/reset-password via curl to double-check. Frontend flows depending on these (QR scanner manual token, Recovery reset) should be re-clicked in the mobile UI.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: (1) POST /api/qr/create as user A → get token. (2) POST /api/qr/scan {token} as user B → 500. Backend log: 'TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes' in resolve_session. Cause: Motor deserializes BSON dates without tzinfo; now_utc() is tz-aware. Mitigation: add tz_aware=True to AsyncIOMotorClient OR patch the two comparison sites.
